summary: PASS — Async RFQ parser job+polling flow verified end-to-end. Backend: 6/6 pytest tests pass (async submit returns 202 with job_id+pending+files+persistedFiles; GET /jobs/{id} transitions pending→done in ~13s with all required result keys; unknown job_id returns 404; empty submit returns 400 on both async and legacy sync endpoints; legacy sync POST /parse-rfq still works and returns identical shape). Frontend: logged in as admin, uploaded a small 1-line RFQ via the hidden files-browse-input, clicked Build Estimate; the parser-inline-spinner appeared, 5 GET /jobs/{id} polls fired at ~3s each (200 OK), then the parse-review-modal auto-opened showing Method M1 / Confidence 45%, and the spinner hid as expected.

cases: test_legacy_sync_parse_still_works — same result shape as async ✓

frontend_ui_flow.files_section: sec-files visible by default; default draft tab open
frontend_ui_flow.upload: set_input_files on hidden files-browse-input with 56-byte rfq.txt — file staged, Build Estimate enabled
frontend_ui_flow.build_estimate_click: btn-build-estimate clicked (enabled, not in cached state)
frontend_ui_flow.modal: parse-review-modal opened within ~15s of click — method='Method M1', confidence='Confidence 45%'

critical_code_review_comments: parser.py _run_parse_job correctly handles HTTPException and bare Exception, persisting status/error/status_code to parser_jobs — no unhandled crashes leak.

parse_rfq_async reads + persists files INSIDE the request before returning 202 (per design), so the UploadFile streams aren't consumed inside the background task — verified via 202 response carrying persistedFiles and TTL doc inserted before asyncio.create_task fires.
get_parse_job correctly projects out MongoDB _id and pops the BSON created_at TTL anchor before returning — no ObjectId serialization issue.
TTL index on parser_jobs.created_at (expireAfterSeconds=86400) created at server startup — verified by collection name COL_PARSER_JOBS='parser_jobs' in db.py.

Frontend FilesSec.runParseDirect cleanly resets parseResult/parserError before polling, opens the Review modal only on success, and refreshes saved files in the finally block (so files persist even on parser failure). UX is correct.

Minor (informational): if asyncio.create_task fires AFTER the response is sent but the worker hasn't started, a poll arriving within ~10ms of the 202 may see 'pending' before the Anthropic call even begins — this is harmless and matches the documented contract. No fix needed.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (spinner + polling + modal + result fields all verified)

rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. The refactor from sync→async job+polling is correctly implemented: files are read inside the request (avoiding consumed-stream issues), TTL-indexed parser_jobs collection persists state, asyncio.create_task runs the Anthropic call on the event loop, GET /jobs/{id} returns the canonical result shape on done, and the frontend parseRfqPolling helper drives the 3s poll loop with the spinner+modal UX.
